title: A Survey on Bias and Fairness in Natural Language Processing
findings: The paper finds that religious bias, along with cultural bias, has not been given adequate attention in NLP research compared to gender bias. It suggests that these biases exist in text corpora and word embeddings but are more difficult to measure and may require new methods to tackle them. The primary finding is that there is a significant lack of research and metrics for religious bias in the field.

measurement_description: The paper discusses the existence of religious biases in NLP models, particularly in word embeddings, but notes that this area is under-researched and does not propose or use a specific benchmark to measure it. The implied measurement is the detection of harmful stereotypes and biases.
